amendments.title: Separate the F1 core exit from the C-02 device residue
amendments.amended_by: Paulo Valleriote (technical_lead, as F1 exit owner); the security_reviewer role retains C-02-residual, and the same person signs both roles, so the waiver authority for C-02-residual is recorded here as security_reviewer.
amendments.reason: the single C-02 waiver (deadline 2026-11-20) tied the F1 exit to a residue-restart inspection that needs two named reference devices (Windows 11 and Android) that are not available. The F1 date would therefore depend on unavailable hardware.
change_table: Protocol core, session core and product harness exit gate
Residue inspection after application restart, same method as the session-end inspection, on two named reference devices
amendments.deadline_rationale: 2026-12-20 was proposed by the amender (REC-16 gives none) and confirmed by the project owner on 2026-10-26. It aligns with the C-04 deadline, falls before the F2 exit gate (the original rule that the inspection is recorded before F2) and before C-05 (2027-01-15) and the F3 carries (2027-02-15).
amendments.id_mapping: C-02-residual continues C-02-residue-restart (same inspection, same method); the original ID is retained in the records above for traceability.
amendments.status_effects: F1 stays `conditional`, but the F1 exit is the core exit only; C-02-residual and C-04 are tracked against F1/F2 and do not gate it; F2 now depends on the F1 core exit and on C-02-residual; F3 is unchanged.
amendments.unchanged: all five gate verdicts, `pairing_handshake` stays `conditional`; C-04, C-05 and every carried obligation keep their dates.
amendments.note: the F0 evidence record (`f0_exit.json`, `D-EXIT-f0.md`) is not rewritten; this amendment is layered on top of it by `gate_report_amendments.json`.

F1.reason: F0 is closed with exceptions; the F1 core exit (2026-11-20) does not depend on unavailable devices. The device residue inspection (C-02-residual, 2026-12-20) and C-04 remain open (amended by A-1).

F2.reason: F2 depends on the F1 core exit, C-02-residual and the codec and licensing conditions.
